scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of old and new architecture, including a large yellow banner on the side of a building, with pedestrians walking along the sidewalk and a few cars parked along the curb. The street is lined with trees and has a few streetlights and utility poles. The sky is overcast with clouds.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are primarily beige and tan, with some having balconies and others featuring ornate facades. Some have signs or advertisements displayed.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has white lines painted on it, indicating lanes and pedestrian crossings. There are also several yellow barriers placed along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans placed along the sidewalk, as well as a few bicycles parked near the curb.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are mostly bare, suggesting it may be winter or early spring.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted on the buildings, including a large yellow sign on the side of one building.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area appears to be residential, with a mix of apartments and shops.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The area is a great spot for nature, with plenty of parks and gardens.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The area is a great spot for relaxation, with plenty of beaches and waterways.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is a great place to eat, with plenty of restaurants and cafes.
